contract.administration_semantics: These are authored source assertions. Do not create MedicationAdministration or simulator audit events from them. No prose dose/route/time/status extraction.
contract.consumer_expectation: Discharge must describe administration evidence as not established when no canonical administration records exist. Medication interaction validation must report unresolved selected encounter care context instead of silently treating it as absent.
contract.coverage_limit: A finite field allowlist cannot establish all medications or absence of administrations from generic narratives. Existing catch-all notes remain visible. Never claim comprehensive clinical validation.
contract.label_limit: Some currently visible source note/reason/issue strings carry authored clinical judgments. Preserve as source wording; do not reclassify as independent observed or verified findings.
contract.projection: One record per explicitly allowlisted direct patient field: source_collection, source_path, deep-copied whole source_data. Retain empty collections, item order, mixed content, raw times, qualifiers and field grouping.
contract.timing_limit: Reported per-event time, total dose, last-dose time, and date-only history have distinct meanings; preserve raw values without inferred date/zone or event expansion.
